SELECT 
  dir_paissubdiv.Descr AS Departamento,
  COUNT(*) AS TotalRegistros
FROM
  flow_coordina f
  INNER JOIN pac_ficha ON f.CodPac = pac_ficha.Cod
  INNER JOIN salud_paciente ON pac_ficha.Cod = salud_paciente.NroHistoria
  INNER JOIN dir_comunica ON salud_paciente.k_id = dir_comunica.IdRegistro
  INNER JOIN dir_comunicadir ON dir_comunicadir.IdComunica = dir_comunica.k_id
  INNER JOIN dir_paislocalidad ON dir_paislocalidad.k_id = dir_comunicadir.IdLocalidad
  INNER JOIN dir_paissubdiv ON dir_paissubdiv.k_id = dir_paislocalidad.IdPaisSubDiv
WHERE
  dir_comunicadir.IdLocalidad > 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y') > 2004 AND f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120)
GROUP BY
  dir_paissubdiv.Descr
ORDER BY
  TotalRegistros DESC;

SELECT 
    AVG(fc.EdadCoo) AS Promedio,
    s.Descr AS Sexo
FROM flow_coordina fc
INNER JOIN salud_paciente sp ON sp.NroHistoria = fc.CodPac
INNER JOIN dir_sexo s ON s.k_id = sp.IdSexo AND sp.IdSexo > 0
WHERE fc.Realizado = 255 AND fc.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120) AND DATE_FORMAT(fc.`FechaRealizado`, '%Y') > 2004 AND DATE_FORMAT(fc.`FechaRealizado`, '%Y') <= {{anio}}
GROUP BY Sexo;

SELECT 
    SUM(p.VentilaH + (p.VentilaD * 24)) AS Horas FROM sqlpvd_masterpp p
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ff.Cod
    FROM flow_coordina ff
    WHERE ff.Realizado = 255
      AND ff.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120)
    ORDER BY ff.FechaRealizado DESC
    LIMIT 35
) sub
    ON p.CodMaster = sub.Cod

SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y') AS Periodo, 
  COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM sqlflow_coordina f
WHERE f.`Realizado` = 255 AND f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120) AND DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y') > 2004 AND DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaRealizado, '%Y') < 2026

ORDER BY Periodo;

SELECT
    AVG(DATEDIFF(f.FechaRealizado,f.FechaFinTramite)) AS promedio_dias
FROM flow_coordina f
WHERE f.Realizado=255 AND f.Autorizado = 255 AND DATE_FORMAT(f.FechaInput, '%Y') > 2004 AND DATEDIFF(f.FechaRealizado, f.FechaFinTramite) > 0
AND  f.FechaRealizado > '1900-01-01' AND f.FechaFinTramite > '1900-01-01' AND (f.`CodCoordinaReglaMotivo` = 105 OR f.`CodCoordinaReglaMotivo` = 109 OR f.`CodCoordinaReglaMotivo` = 120)

SELECT 
    ms.Tipo AS Sector,
    AVG(m.Estadia) AS Promedio
FROM flow_coordina f
INNER JOIN flow_coordinamapeo m 
    ON f.Cod = m.CodCoordina
INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc 
    ON m.IdPlantaContenido = pc.k_id
INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc2 
    ON pc2.k_id = pc.IdContenido
INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc3 
    ON pc3.k_id = pc2.IdContenido
INNER JOIN mapeosector ms 
    ON pc2.k_id = ms.IdPlantaContenido
WHERE f.Realizado = 255
  AND f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120)
  AND YEAR(f.FechaRealizado) = {{Anio}}
GROUP BY ms.Tipo
ORDER BY ms.Tipo;

SELECT 
    ms.Tipo AS Sector,
    AVG(m.Estadia) AS Promedio
FROM (
    SELECT Cod, FechaRealizado, Realizado, CodCoordinaReglaMotivo
    FROM flow_coordina
    WHERE Realizado = 255
      AND CodCoordinaReglaMotivo IN (105, 109, 120)
    ORDER BY FechaRealizado DESC
    LIMIT 35
) f
INNER JOIN flow_coordinamapeo m 
    ON f.Cod = m.CodCoordina
INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc 
    ON m.IdPlantaContenido = pc.k_id
INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc2 
    ON pc2.k_id = pc.IdContenido
INNER JOIN use_plantacontenido pc3 
    ON pc3.k_id = pc2.IdContenido
INNER JOIN mapeosector ms 
    ON pc2.k_id = ms.IdPlantaContenido
GROUP BY ms.Tipo
ORDER BY ms.Tipo;

SELECT 
    d.Descr AS Diagnostico,
    COUNT(*) AS Total,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / t.TotalGeneral, 2) AS Porcentaje
FROM (
    SELECT CodDiagno1 AS CodDiagno FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CodDiagno2 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CodDiagno3 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno3 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CodDiagno4 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno4 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CodDiagno5 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno5 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CodDiagno6 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno6 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CodDiagno7 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno7 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CodDiagno8 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno8 IS NOT NULL
) diag
INNER JOIN med_blockdiagnosticotree d 
    ON diag.CodDiagno = d.k_id
JOIN (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalGeneral
    FROM (
        SELECT CodDiagno1 AS CodDiagno FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno1 IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CodDiagno2 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno2 IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CodDiagno3 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno3 IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CodDiagno4 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno4 IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CodDiagno5 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno5 IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CodDiagno6 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno6 IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CodDiagno7 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno7 IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CodDiagno8 FROM flow_procedimientocardiologiablockdetalle WHERE CodDiagno8 IS NOT NULL
    ) all_diag
) t
WHERE d.Descr IS NOT NULL   -- 🔑 evita que aparezca (NULL) en el resultado
GROUP BY d.Descr, t.TotalGeneral
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 10;

FROM sqlflow_coordina f
Inner join med_tecnicadetalle m on m.Cod = f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo
